approaches.name: Token-first dark retheme on existing shadcn base + curated component ports
approaches.summary: Re-skin through globals.css tokens (force dark default, mono accents, grid/glow utilities) and extend existing common/ components (kpi-card, data-table, status-badge) rather than adopt a starter; port patterns, not code, from shadcn-admin and next-shadcn-dashboard-starter.
how: Set defaultTheme=dark in next-themes; retune .dark oklch tokens + add --glow/--grid-line vars; Geist Mono for numerics.
Extend kpi-card with sparkline/delta props; add a /dashboard page using recharts via shadcn chart wrapper (already installed).
Dashboard cards: receipts matched, money applied by currency, per-model accuracy/cost/adjudicator agreement/auto-fix rate fed from reports.py + llm_usage.py.
Restyle exceptions via the shared data-table/status-badge only; no per-page CSS.
evidence: https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse and https://github.com/Helicone/helicone for LLM cost/latency/quality card layouts
risks: Starters bring auth/state conventions that clash with OIDC-cookie proxy; copy layout only
Contrast/accessibility of neon accents on dark; keep status colours semantic
recharts theming under Tailwind v4 needs CSS-var colours

approaches.name: Evolve shared llm-chat to payroll-compare layout with proposed-change cards (ai-elements patterns)
approaches.summary: Keep the single llm-chat component; restyle to the aix-payroll-compare chat (activity rows, reasoning, tool-activity, context chips, composer plugins) and add a structured 'proposed rule change' action card with diff and Apply/Reject, modelled on ai-elements confirmation/plan/queue and payroll-compare's tool-ui-host.
how: Mirror D:\AIX-Payroll-Compare\webapp\src eatures\chat\ui\activity (assistant-message-parts, tool-activity-row, reasoning-row) as parts under components/common/llm-chat/.
Haiku returns a structured output {message, proposals:[{rule_key, before, after, rationale}]} via the chat API; SSE streams text then proposals.
Render proposals as diff cards (before/after) with Apply calling a permission-gated config endpoint with Principal audit trail; nothing auto-applies.
Props: context, systemPromptKey, actions (existing); add proposal renderer slot.
evidence: https://github.com/vercel/ai-elements (confirmation.tsx, plan.tsx, queue.tsx, prompt-input.tsx, message.tsx, reasoning.tsx)
risks: ai-elements assumes Vercel AI SDK message format; port visuals only, keep own SSE reducer
Proposal apply must be validated server-side against config schema (LLM output is untrusted)
Rule refinement without a dry-run/backtest gives no evidence; add 'preview impact on recent items'

approaches.name: Failed-receipt upload as drag-drop multi-file queue feeding the existing intake path
approaches.summary: A shared dropzone component with per-file thumbnails/progress/remove, one POST per file (or multipart batch) to a new FastAPI router that hashes, stores in Object Storage and creates a work item flagged for in-depth review; UI polls/SSEs the item for review result.
how: react-dropzone (or native drag events) in components/common/image-dropzone with preview via URL.createObjectURL, per-file status states.
Next route handler streams multipart to FastAPI; API enforces type/size limits, content-hash dedupe, stores artifact, creates work_item stage=deep_review.
Review runner reuses extract/adjudicate at high effort; result shown on /items/[id] via existing artifact-viewer and history-timeline.
Review queue list = data-table filtered to source=manual_upload.
risks: Untrusted image content: validate magic bytes, size caps, strip EXIF, never log content
Images may contain prompt-injection text; extraction is structured-output only
Large batch upload through Next proxy body limits; set explicit limit or presign to Object Storage
